entries.header: theorem M6.Character.sign_add : ∀ (a b : ZMod 2), M6.Character.sign (a+b) = M6.Character.sign a * M6.Character.sign b
entries.note: source header, not elaborated; implementation omitted

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.sign_eq_one : ∀ (a : ZMod 2), (M6.Character.sign a = 1 ↔ a = 0) ∧ (M6.Character.sign a = -1 ↔ a ≠ 0)
entries.note: source header, not elaborated; implementation omitted

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.character_add : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q r z : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.character (q+r) z = M6.Character.character q z * M6.Character.character r z
entries.note: source header, not elaborated; implementation omitted

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.sign_sum : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → ZMod 2), M6.Character.sign (∑ i, f i) = ∏ i, M6.Character.sign (f i)
entries.note: source header, not elaborated; implementation omitted

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.character_product : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q z : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.character q z = ∏ i, M6.Character.sign (q i * z i)

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.orthogonality : ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Submodule (ZMod 2) (M6.Character.Vector m)) (z : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.characterSum D z = M6.Character.orthogonalIndicator D z

entries.header: theorem M6.Character.weighted_factorization : ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin m → ZMod 2 → Polynomial ℤ) (q : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.localTransform w q = ∑ z : M6.Character.Vector m, Polynomial.C (M6.Character.character q z) * ∏ i, w i (z i)
